title: EXPERIMENTAL: THE LAST SWITCH (PARTY SEED)
why: The experimental page gets its last switch, the party seed, on by default and read live on the machine that starts the run. Off, a party record locks no seed, no sector and no code, so every demo run builds its own raid, and the operator card stops naming a seed (the armed note ends at clears tonights best, the cleared note says board cleared).
now: The experimental page switches the party seed.
